theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lpip_bilipschitz_measure_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ Z : Set (Euclid n), Z ⊆ A → ENNReal.ofReal m ^ n * volume Z ≤ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ∧ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * volume Z
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
